name: module-size-scope
body: Scope and observable completion for the budget: it applies to first-party Rust production source under `src/` (excluding `vendor/` and generated files); test files (`src/<module>/tests.rs`, `tests/**`) are excluded, and so are the per-language frontend crates in this change-set. Completion is observable by enumerating first-party production source files and their line counts and finding none over the budget (a note may justify an exception).
